title: Saṅkhitta
text: 2. Pañcimani bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || 3. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānaṃ samattā paripūrattā arahaṃ hoti- -saddhānusārī hoti || || 4. Iti kho bhikkhave paripūram paripūrakārī ārādheti || padesaṃ padesakārī ārādheti || avañjhānitvevāham bhikkhave pañcindriyāni vadāmīti || ||
